note: (Loops and People, 11 Nov: lines, where an ad has it, are the lines from docs/world-designer/words.md: each of the brand's boards takes the next one, going round; house.lines the same for the house boards. line is kept for an ad with no lines.) Billboards along SunnyBay's main roads (City job A). slots: how many boards stand in the city (8 to 12). Each ad: brand (the big word), line (the small one), image (optional: a picture drawn over the whole board, 2:1, e.g. /img/ads/woza.webp; empty draws the brand and line in bg/fg colours), link (optional: opens when a player taps the board and then Visit), start and end (dates, YYYY-MM-DD, both inclusive; outside them the ad is not shown), boards (how many boards it takes, default 1). A board with no ad shows a University of Mzansi house ad (house: the line for those, {house} is the house's name). Brands allowed: Woza, Lifecup, Greenway. (Job J, 12 Nov: the game's own features come first now, then the brand ads, then two empty brand slots, then the house ads: features.lines are Cursor's billboard lines from docs/world-designer/alive.md. walls: how many side-wall slots on the lots' buildings take ads after the twelve roadside boards. To put a brand on a board: add it to ads (brand, line or lines, image: a same-site path such as /img/ads/brand.webp at 2:1, link, start, end, boards). slots_for_brands are the placeholders shown until then.)

lines: Wave at someone. Campus gets smaller.
Things to do behind every door.
Race the pier. Gulls will judge you.
Start on R2,100. See if you last.
Taxi. Hand sign. Story in the back.
Make the card. Your face, official-ish.
Ask a friend for food. Become a legend.
SunnyBay Eats. Hot tray, your door.
The Daily is arguing. You should too.
